arStrings.szText: If an enemy survives more than {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} hits from {c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} then each subsequent hit increases its damage versus that target by {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|x%|]{/c} and extends its lifetime by {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}60{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and now summons a demon for {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} seconds that moves with you and attacks for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_VANGUARD}{/c} damage per swipe.

{c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} becomes an {c_important}Abyss{/c} {c_important}Recast{/c} Skill and now summons a demon for {c_number}{SF_21}{/c} seconds that attacks for {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_ABYSS}{/c} damage per swipe. Recast to command the demon to do a massive smash that Pulls in enemies and explodes for {c_number}{payload:RIFT_IMPACT}{/c} damage.
{c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for each Nearby enemy present when it is summoned, up to {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Casting {c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} increases the damage of your {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills by {c_number}[{SF_29}*100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage against Elite enemies and Bosses.
{c_important}Fiend of Abaddon{/c} now costs {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} Dominance and has no Cooldown.
